question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
pred_sql:
WITH EnrollmentDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EnrollmentDifference
    FROM 
        frpm f
    INNER JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.FundingType = 'Local'
),
AverageDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(EnrollmentDifference) AS AvgDifference
    FROM 
        EnrollmentDifference
)
SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN 
    EnrollmentDifference ed ON s.CDSCode = ed.CDSCode
CROSS JOIN 
    AverageDifference ad
WHERE 
    ed.EnrollmentDifference > ad.AvgDifference;
